name: GitHub Copilot SDK — via Foundry project endpoint
summary: Copilot SDK BYOK provider pointed at the Foundry project /openai/v1/ URL with a `{conn}/{model}` BYOM prefix in the model field.
description: The GitHub Copilot SDK (github/copilot-sdk) supports BYOK against OpenAI-compatible endpoints. Pointing it at the Foundry **project-level** endpoint (`{project_endpoint}/openai/v1/`) with `wire_api="responses"` and `model="{apim-conn}/{deployment}"` (as `wire_model`) makes Foundry parse the prefix and route to the APIM connection the same way it does for direct Responses API calls. Auth uses a `bearer_token_provider` backed by `DefaultAzureCredential`, so Entra tokens refresh on every request without a caller-managed loop.
notes:
Verified: the scheduled CI run genuinely executes a Copilot session against `{project_endpoint}/openai/v1/` with `wire_model='{connection}/{deployment}'` and asserts a non-empty assistant response — this is a real end-to-end pass, not an env-var skip. See the `feature-copilot-sdk-via-foundry.yml` run history for the latest result. Docs: https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/foundry/how-to/develop/sdk-auth; sample: https://github.com/github/copilot-sdk/blob/main/docs/auth/byok.md.

Endpoint gotcha: the `byok.md` sample uses `https://<resource>.openai.azure.com/openai/v1/`, which is the account-level AOAI endpoint and cannot see Foundry connections; BYOM prefixes 404 there. Use `https://<account>.services.ai.azure.com/api/projects/<project>/openai/v1/`, `wire_api: 'responses'`, and `bearer_token_provider` so Entra tokens refresh on every request.
